summary: EESTI ENERGIA AS (LEI 5493005044RTLQ5RZU70, Estonian registry code 10421629) is identifier-confirmed and registered in Estonia. The Government of Estonia is reported as a shareholder by OpenSanctions and indicated as controlling owner on Wikidata, making the entity a possible state-owned enterprise; these are indicative findings from aggregator and crowd-sourced sources, not authoritative determinations. The Estonian e-Business Register (high confidence) records four current board members — Andrus Durejko, Marlen Tamm, Lauri Karp, and Gerrit Mäesalu — alongside several supervisory or other-means role-holders including Jürgen Ligi, against whose name multiple PEP matches were returned by OpenSanctions, EveryPolitician, and OpenAleph; all matches are name-only with no corroborating birth date or nationality, so identity is unconfirmed. GLEIF data raises two structural risk signals at medium confidence: an opaque ownership chain containing an anonymous entity, and an ownership structure of three or more corporate layers meeting the AMLA threshold; GLEIF also records a reporting exception whereby an unknown parent does not consolidate the subject. One material limitation applies: OpenSanctions data is licensed CC-BY-NC-4.0 and may not be commercially re-used under that licence.

claims.text: EESTI ENERGIA AS (LEI 5493005044RTLQ5RZU70, Estonian registry code 10421629) is identifier-confirmed and registered in Estonia.

The Government of Estonia is reported as a shareholder in Eesti Energia AS by OpenSanctions, and is indicated as controlling owner on Wikidata, making the entity a possible state-owned enterprise; these are indicative findings from aggregator and crowd-sourced sources, not authoritative determinations.

The Estonian e-Business Register records four current board members: Andrus Durejko (from 2023-04-03), Marlen Tamm (from 2023-04-03), Lauri Karp (from 2024-09-10), and Gerrit Mäesalu (from 2026-06-22).

The Estonian e-Business Register also records several individuals holding other means roles, including Jürgen Ligi (from 2024-08-02), Kristi Klaas (from 2024-06-10), Kaur Kajak (from 2023-04-18), Anne Mere (from 2022-07-19), Anna Broughel (from 2025-06-02), Priit Rohumaa (from 2025-06-02), and Gerrit Mäesalu (from 2026-07-06).

Jürgen Ligi, a related party recorded in the Estonian e-Business Register, shares a name with PEP records on OpenSanctions, EveryPolitician, and OpenAleph (including via US CIA World Leaders, Wikidata PEPs, and MySociety's EveryPolitician Legislators); all matches are name-only with no corroborating birth date or nationality, so identity is unconfirmed.
GLEIF data raises a medium-confidence structural risk signal of opaque ownership, with the ownership chain containing an anonymous entity.
GLEIF data raises a medium-confidence structural risk signal of complex ownership layers, with the ownership chain having three corporate layers, meeting the AMLA threshold of three or more.
GLEIF records a reporting exception whereby an unknown parent does not consolidate EESTI ENERGIA AS, leaving the ultimate parent unidentified in the LEI record.

EESTI ENERGIA AS is recorded by GLEIF as the direct parent (accounting consolidation) of Enefit OÜ, Enefit Oy, and ENEFIT INDUSTRY AS, and by OpenSanctions as holding a shareholding in Attarat Power Co. and Enefit Green.

The ownership chain structurally reaches jurisdictions outside the EU/EEA (specifically Jordan, JO), noted as a structural observation; this is not a risk finding under the AMLA CDD RTS or AMLR Annex III.

The GLEIF LEI record contains a reporting exception: an unknown parent does not consolidate EESTI ENERGIA AS, leaving the ultimate beneficial owner unidentified through the LEI chain (f1, f2).

State ownership and control indicators are sourced from OpenSanctions (aggregator) and Wikidata (crowd-sourced); neither constitutes an authoritative beneficial ownership register disclosure (f9, f10).

All PEP matches for Jürgen Ligi are name-only across OpenSanctions, EveryPolitician, and OpenAleph — no birth date or nationality corroboration is available to confirm or exclude identity (r5, r6, r7, r8, r9).

risks.label: Outside EU/EEA
risks.rationale: Ownership chain reaches jurisdictions outside the EU/EEA: JO.
